================================================================================
PETIKA — CUSTOMER SUPPORT & ASSISTANCE POLICY
================================================================================

Dear Buyer,

Thank you for choosing Petika! We take immense pride in crafting commercial-grade, 
ultra-clean HTML5 templates that make customization fast, pleasant, and seamless.

SUPPORT CHANNELS & ASSISTANCE
=============================
- Documentation: Please review the included "documentation/index.html" manual first, 
  which answers 95% of customization questions.
- Support Email: support@kdthemes.com
- Response Time: Typically within 12 to 24 business hours (Monday – Friday, UTC).

WHAT IS COVERED UNDER TEMPLATE SUPPORT:
=======================================
✓ Assistance with reported bugs or layout inconsistencies in the original codebase.
✓ Clarification regarding template features, CSS variables, and documentation.
✓ Guidance on third-party plugin integration as documented in the manual.
✓ Updates and bug fixes for browser compatibility or Bootstrap updates.

WHAT IS NOT COVERED:
====================
✗ Extensive custom design overhaul or bespoke feature development.
✗ Third-party backend server-side scripts (PHP, Node.js mailers, database APIs).
✗ Hosting, DNS, or server configuration support.
✗ Issues arising from major modifications to core Bootstrap files.

NEED CUSTOM DESIGN OR ADVANCED DEVELOPMENT?
===========================================
If you require custom feature additions, backend API integrations, or full 
turnkey deployment, our engineering team is available for bespoke consulting.
Contact: studio@kdthemes.com

Happy building!
— The KD Themes Engineering Team
